The hole is a rectangular prism, so its volume is  

\[
V = 6\text{ ft} \times 4\text{ ft} \times 3\text{ ft}=72\text{ ft}^3 .
\]

Bob shovels 1 ft³ in 3 seconds. The total time required is therefore  

\[
T = 72\text{ ft}^3 \times 3\text{ s/ft}^3 = 216\text{ s}.
\]

The problem statement gives only the dimensions of the hole and the rate “3 seconds per cubic foot.” It does not mention any swell factor, fatigue, or other adjustments, so those extra considerations are outside the scope of the question.

**Final answer:** 216
